title: Undine
author: La Motte-Fouqué, Friedrich Heinrich Karl, Freiherr de
description: "Undine" by Freiherr de Friedrich Heinrich Karl La Motte-Fouqué is a novel written in the early 19th century, renowned for its blend of fairy tale elements and romantic themes.
longDescription: The story revolves around the enchanting character of Undine, a water spirit, and her interactions with humans, particularly Sir Huldbrand, a noble knight.

authorInfo.bio: La Motte-Fouqué, Friedrich Heinrich Karl, Freiherr de (1777–1843) wrote Undine. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
